authoritativeReference.presenceRule: The typed parser requires the core row projection fields; border-family groups are optional. Existing present slots may be edited. Missing slots remain absent and retain their zero model projection; a typed change to a missing slot refuses export instead of synthesizing or dropping the edit.

changes: DXF-origin TABLESTYLE export overlays edits to existing row groups 170, 62/63, 283, 274-279, 284-289, and 64-69; the existing group-140 edit remains enabled.
Alignment, indexed colors, lineweight, Boolean state, and text-height edits are bounded by the typed writer's accepted domains.
All six indices of each of the three border families are edited in the generated ASCII/Binary control and verified through typed readback.

Optional border groups are preserved as sparse raw sequences. A generated control removes row 0 group 279, edits an existing group 140, verifies exact output order/spelling, and refuses a subsequent edit to the absent lineweight slot while preserving an existing destination.
CMC metadata, group 90/91 data/unit values, row identities, and other unmodeled projection state remain equality-checked; no absent raw groups are inserted.
